name: Oh Ghee Inc
old_description: One of the most sacred healing foods with unparalleled therapeutic properties. A superfood for your entire body.
about:
Oh Ghee Inc operates from Bend, Oregon, where it produces a line of ghee-based products for cooking, skincare, and pet care. The company does not publicly state its founding year or ownership structure.

The core product is ghee, a clarified butterfat rendered from organic butter sourced from grass-fed cows. The company processes this ghee into several product categories: culinary ghee for cooking, ghee candles and refills, a skincare line marketed for dry skin and irritation relief, a pet supplement called Dog-Ghee for joint health and digestion, and functional foods that use ghee as a delivery medium for fat-soluble herbs. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed.

The products target health-conscious consumers seeking nutrient-dense fats, individuals with dry or irritated skin, and pet owners looking for natural supplements. The company positions its ghee as a superfood rich in omega-3 and omega-9 fatty acids, vitamins A, D, E, and K, antioxidants, amino acids, minerals, and enzymes.

Oh Ghee emphasizes the therapeutic properties of ghee, describing it as free of inflammatory properties, highly digestible, and offering superior absorbability for fat-soluble nutrients. The brand was born from a passion for sharing ghee’s healing benefits, though specific founder names or origin stories are not provided.
